build.method: installed TypeScript compiler; strict semantic check and JavaScript emit

checks.name: landmarks, table, labels and polite status region exist
search, status filter, empty state and clear-filters recovery
background failure preserves rows, exposes stale indicator, and retry restores freshness
explicit abort preserves previous results and announces cancellation
native modal focuses title, prevents duplicate submit, recovers failed mutation and returns focus
keyboard skip link and visible focus style are available
390px layout contains page overflow and keeps primary controls at least 24px

accessibilityBoundary: Bounded DOM/keyboard/focus/layout/24px-target/reduced-motion checks in one Chromium browser. No full WCAG conformance, screen-reader session, comprehensive contrast audit, zoom/forced-colors coverage, or multi-browser compatibility claim.
raceEvidence: A/B out-of-order completion and same-gate failure/retry are tested in scripts/test-tools.mjs independently of browser abort behavior.
